This '''spy''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]] confronted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], about [[2 ABY/Legends|one year before]] the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Vader used fear and intimidation to interrogate the spy in order to learn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] location.
